_meta.description: Parameter Envelopes — Mathematical Boundaries for Safe Generation
_meta.rationale: Guardrail 2: Prevents the agent from experimenting itself into broken output. All parameters are clamped to these ranges before workflow construction.

flf2v_cinematic.description: First/Last Frame to Video — High-Fidelity Cinematic (Super Noah proven pipeline)

cfg.notes: LTX 2.3 distilled is best at low CFG; above 4.0 causes deep-frying

steps.notes: Distilled model converges fast. 24 is the sweet spot.

width.notes: Must be divisible by 32. Half-res used internally for pass 1.

height.notes: Must be divisible by 32. 576 for 16:9 ratio.

fps.notes: 25fps is broadcast standard. 12fps for retro chunky look.

first_strength.notes: First frame anchor strength. 1.0 for strict consistency.

last_strength.notes: Last frame anchor strength. 1.0 for strict consistency.

img_compression.notes: LTXVPreprocess compression. Lower = sharper but more VRAM.

tile_size.notes: VAEDecodeTiled tile size. Lower = less VRAM.

sigmas.notes: Proven sigma schedules for 2-pass distilled pipeline. DO NOT modify without testing.

i2v_cinematic.description: Image to Video — Single anchor, free ending

t2v_cinematic.description: Text to Video — No anchors, fully generative

crf.notes: Near-lossless. Lower = bigger file. 10 is production quality.

max_clips_per_assembly.notes: Safety limit to prevent FFmpeg OOM

retro_crunch.notes: The 'Retro Crunch' nearest-neighbor filter. Enable for pixel-art projects only.

vram_safety.notes: Sequential rendering only. Parallel shots caused system crash on 2026-05-01.
